name: Volume of |v|
description: Volume rendering of the magnitude of a field file with a colour transfer function (colormap over the data range) and an opacity ramp, a scalar bar, an outline and axes (SimViz scalar volume view).

bindings.name: data
bindings.description: The directory (or Runtime task) holding the field file.

graph.name: Volume of |v|
graph.description: stk.filter.calculator (magnitude) -> stk.render.volume with colour and opacity transfer functions.

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: Field file
parameters.description: Path inside the binding: DAT, NPY, VTI, legacy VTK or VTKHDF.

parameters.name: range
parameters.label: Value range
parameters.description: [min, max] of the transfer functions (null = the data range).

parameters.name: opacity
parameters.label: Opacity points
parameters.description: [x, alpha] pairs, x normalized over the value range.
